name: first-chunk-missing-id-fatal
description: a first TEXT_MESSAGE_CHUNK without a messageId is a violation — a consumer must not invent an identifier
kill: make chunk expansion generate a messageId when the first chunk of a lane carries none

expect.errorContains: First TEXT_MESSAGE_CHUNK must have a messageId

dotnet.intentional: GAP, not a design difference: EventStreamConverter has no case for TEXT_MESSAGE_CHUNK or TOOL_CALL_CHUNK, so a chunk stream falls through to the pass-through branch. Nothing is expanded into a message and none of the chunk-stream rules are enforced. Pinned here so the gap cannot widen or close unnoticed; alignment tracked separately. With no chunk stage there is nothing to require the first chunk's messageId, so the stream is accepted instead of rejected.
